title: Sardines, Sardines! And Lots Of Doors Slamming In Frayne's Farce, Noises Off

contact_edits.before: Noises Off, Michael Frayn's farce about the production of another farce (one that begins in chaos and goes downhill from there), is already a classic. The pace and timing of Brian Bedford's direction are impeccable; some actors have trouble with the distinctively British idiom, but Barry MacGregor (who is British), Chick Reid and Sara Topham are dead-on. And Seana McKenna has a moment of worth-the-price-of-admission comic poetry. (Avon Theatre, Stratford. 1- 800-567-1600. stratfordfestival.ca. Runs to Oct. 30.)
